| Lenis (`lenis.min.js`) | 1.1.18 | MIT (`vendor/lenis/LICENSE`) |
| Cormorant (`fonts/cormorant-*`) | @fontsource/cormorant 5.1.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| Onest (`fonts/onest-*`) | @fontsource-variable/onest 5.1.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| IBM Plex Mono (`fonts/plexmono-*`) | @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.1.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
